description: Known-correct, unit-testable Python functions, each shipped twice: once as written and once with exactly one mutation whose line, class, severity and enclosing function are recorded. The clean half is not filler -- a corpus of nothing but defects would score a model that flags every line as perfect.

mutated.code:
def read_first_line(path):
    """Return the first line of the text file at path."""
    handle = open(path, encoding="utf-8")
    line = handle.readline()
    return line
